'''RIC-920'''<ref name="AEYNTK" /> was a [[Color|brown]]-plated<ref name="AOTC" /> [[RIC-series general labor droid]]<ref name="RIC Databank" /> who worked as a [[rickshaw]] driver in the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. Shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[droid]] transported [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] through Mos Espa to the stall of the [[Toydarian]] [[junk dealer]] [[Watto]]. On Skywalker's request, the droid waited while trio spoke about the location of the [[Jedi]]'s [[Parent|mother]], [[Shmi Skywalker Lars]].<ref name="AOTC" /> RIC-920 stood 1.1 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="AEYNTK" />
